verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's pricing page lists 'Advanced permissioning' (Pro) and 'Advanced access control' (Enterprise). That is a first-party claim of role/permission controls, but the pack contains no docs describing roles, per-flag or per-project permission scoping, or how it works. The readonly SDK Connection Endpoint covers SDK delivery rather than scoped management API tokens, and approval workflows are an adjacent control, so neither is credited. Missing for 10: documentation of roles and permission granularity (which users can change which flags), scoped or restricted REST API tokens, per-project or per-environment permission scoping, and independent corroboration.
